contracts.behavior: createElement applies safe attributes and textContent, and only PARTIALLY blocks dangerous attributes: it blocks attribute names that START with a lowercase 'on' (e.g. onclick, onClick, onCLICK) and names that are EXACTLY 'style', warning via console.warn per blocked attribute. The filter is CASE-SENSITIVE (`key.startsWith('on') || key === 'style'`), so mixed-case variants that do NOT begin with lowercase 'on' (ONCLICK, OnLoad) or that are not exactly 'style' (Style, STYLE) BYPASS the filter and are applied — a bypassed ONCLICK becomes a live inline onclick handler and Style/STYLE sets inline style. It does NOT block 'on* generally'.
